public.daily_margin_by_site.definition: select "project_id", "location_id", "trx_date", coalesce(sum(case when "kind" = 'sales' then "total" else 0 end), 0) as "sales", coalesce(sum(case when "kind" = 'cost' then "total" else 0 end), 0) as "cost", coalesce(sum(case when "kind" = 'sales' then "total" else -"total" end), 0) as "margin" from "daily_transactions" group by "daily_transactions"."project_id", "daily_transactions"."location_id", "daily_transactions"."trx_date"
public.daily_margin_by_site.name: daily_margin_by_site

public.margin_by_month.definition: select "project_id", "location_id", to_char("trx_date", 'YYYY-MM') as "period", coalesce(sum(case when "kind" = 'sales' then "total" else 0 end), 0) as "sales", coalesce(sum(case when "kind" = 'cost' then "total" else 0 end), 0) as "cost", coalesce(sum(case when "kind" = 'sales' then "total" else -"total" end), 0) as "margin" from "daily_transactions" group by "daily_transactions"."project_id", "daily_transactions"."location_id", to_char("daily_transactions"."trx_date", 'YYYY-MM')
public.margin_by_month.name: margin_by_month

public.project_performance.definition: select "project_id", coalesce(sum(case when "kind" = 'sales' then "total" else 0 end), 0) as "sales", coalesce(sum(case when "kind" = 'cost' then "total" else 0 end), 0) as "cost", coalesce(sum(case when "kind" = 'sales' then "total" else -"total" end), 0) as "margin", count(distinct "location_id") as "site_count" from "daily_transactions" group by "daily_transactions"."project_id"
public.project_performance.name: project_performance

public.cost_by_site.definition: select "daily_transaction_lines"."project_id", "daily_transaction_lines"."location_id", "daily_transaction_lines"."category_key", max("daily_transaction_lines"."label") as "label", coalesce(sum("daily_transaction_lines"."amount"), 0) as "amount" from "daily_transaction_lines" inner join "daily_transactions" on ("daily_transaction_lines"."transaction_id" = "daily_transactions"."id" and "daily_transactions"."kind" = 'cost') group by "daily_transaction_lines"."project_id", "daily_transaction_lines"."location_id", "daily_transaction_lines"."category_key"
public.cost_by_site.name: cost_by_site

public.cost_by_month.definition: select "project_id", "location_id", to_char("trx_date", 'YYYY-MM') as "period", coalesce(sum("total"), 0) as "cost", count(*) as "transactions" from "daily_transactions" where "daily_transactions"."kind" = 'cost' group by "daily_transactions"."project_id", "daily_transactions"."location_id", to_char("daily_transactions"."trx_date", 'YYYY-MM')
public.cost_by_month.name: cost_by_month

public.cost_by_area.definition: select "project_id", "location_id", coalesce("area", '(Tanpa Area)') as "area", coalesce(sum("total"), 0) as "cost", count(*) as "transactions" from "daily_transactions" where "daily_transactions"."kind" = 'cost' group by "daily_transactions"."project_id", "daily_transactions"."location_id", coalesce("daily_transactions"."area", '(Tanpa Area)')
public.cost_by_area.name: cost_by_area

public.sales_by_site.definition: select "daily_transaction_lines"."project_id", "daily_transaction_lines"."location_id", "daily_transaction_lines"."category_key", max("daily_transaction_lines"."label") as "label", coalesce(sum("daily_transaction_lines"."amount"), 0) as "amount" from "daily_transaction_lines" inner join "daily_transactions" on ("daily_transaction_lines"."transaction_id" = "daily_transactions"."id" and "daily_transactions"."kind" = 'sales') group by "daily_transaction_lines"."project_id", "daily_transaction_lines"."location_id", "daily_transaction_lines"."category_key"
public.sales_by_site.name: sales_by_site

public.invoice_by_site.definition: select "project_id", "location_id", "status", "aging_bucket", count(*) as "count", coalesce(sum("amount"), 0) as "amount" from "invoices" where "invoices"."deleted_at" is null group by "invoices"."project_id", "invoices"."location_id", "invoices"."status", "invoices"."aging_bucket"
public.invoice_by_site.name: invoice_by_site

public.approval_by_site.definition: select "project_id", "location_id", "subject_type", "current_stage", "status", count(*) as "count" from "approvals" group by "approvals"."project_id", "approvals"."location_id", "approvals"."subject_type", "approvals"."current_stage", "approvals"."status"
public.approval_by_site.name: approval_by_site

public.approval_overdue_by_site.definition: select "project_id", "location_id", count(*) filter (where "status" <> 'completed') as "in_progress", count(*) filter (where "status" <> 'completed' and "due_date" < current_date) as "overdue" from "approvals" group by "approvals"."project_id", "approvals"."location_id"
public.approval_overdue_by_site.name: approval_overdue_by_site

public.all_attachments.definition:
select "id", 'invoice' as "source", "invoice_id" as "entity_id", "project_id", "location_id",
      "category", "file_name", "file_type", "size_bytes", "storage_key", "uploaded_by", "created_at"
    from "invoice_attachments"
    union all
    select "id", 'transaction' as "source", "transaction_id" as "entity_id", "project_id", "location_id",
      "category", "file_name", "file_type", "size_bytes", "storage_key", "uploaded_by", "created_at"
    from "transaction_attachments"
    union all
    select "id", 'evidence' as "source", "id" as "entity_id", "project_id", "location_id",
      "kind" as "category", "file_name", "file_type", "size_bytes", "storage_key", "uploaded_by", "uploaded_at" as "created_at"
    from "evidence_attachments"
    where "deleted_at" is null
    union all
    select "id", 'dana_cash' as "source", "transaction_id" as "entity_id", "project_id", "location_id",
      null::varchar as "category", "file_name", "file_type", "size_bytes", "storage_key", "uploaded_by", "created_at"
    from "dana_cash_attachments"
public.all_attachments.name: all_attachments
